parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity or same-sex conduct and functioning courts that have overturned bans and ordered a prison transfer support safety, but a visitor can be outed and humiliatingly detained at the border with surgery demanded and no airport protocol, custody defaults to segregation instead of gender-identity placement with no visitor-facing placement rule, and 2025 shows rising homophobic/transphobic violence including dating-app ambushes bearing disproportionately on trans people. Remedies exist yet are case-by-case and uncertain for a short-stay foreigner.

entry_documents.exposure: Border screening can out a traveller; 2023 airport account of humiliating questioning/detainment and 'if you don't undergo surgery, you're still a male'; no airport regulations for trans travellers documented.
entry_documents.protection: Legal gender change without surgery since 2015 and 2024 dead-name removal law are resident-facing climate signals; visitor relies on home passport. Documented.
entry_documents.interaction: Document/presentation mismatch triggers airport gender-identity screening, which can lead to humiliating search and detention; 2023 police search regulation followed complaints.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Custody practice isolates/segregates trans prisoners rather than placement matching gender identity; trans women have been held in men's prisons; humiliating searches of trans detainees prompted 2023 regulation.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: 2019 court ordered HRT and transfer to women's prison, though initially separate wing; further housing petition outcome unreported.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: No statute/regulation on placement documented; case-by-case judicial relief for a detained foreign visitor is uncertain, so segregation remains operative default.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No bathroom, ward, sauna or gender-segregated facility restriction for visitors is stated.

care_services.exposure: Single approval committee with stringent dysphoria opinions; many residents pay out-of-pocket or travel abroad. HRT import/customs for visitors not documented.
care_services.protection: Public insurance can cover treatment with committee approval at the designated hospital; 2019 court ordered HRT for a prisoner.
care_services.interaction: Resident approval system does not establish visitor continuity of care; not_documented for visitor access.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2025 violence rose and foreign-leader rhetoric reportedly inflaming local climate; airport officers framing non-surgical trans people as male is state threat-framing in practice.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex acts decriminalised 1988; violent crimes motivated by sexual orientation treated as hate crimes with double punishment; 2020 court enforced service provision; whether gender identity is a named ground is unresolved.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Protections operate through courts, but border/custody practice documented above is not pre-empted by them for visitors.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No visitor-family, minor travel, or guardianship rule specific to trans travellers is stated.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 2025 official data: 433 homophobic/transphobic physical incidents, dating-app traps and organised ambushes, trans people bearing brunt, record high reported; earlier lethal attacks 2005/2015 and 2009. Raw count has no denominator.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime double punishment documented; police allocated thousands to secure a 2007 Pride; perpetrator received 10-year sentence in earlier case. Current prosecution outcomes not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Patterned ambushes elevate risk beyond isolated incidents, but magnitude/per-capita rate and visitor-specific targeting are not documented.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No airport protocol; no prison-placement regulation; visitor extension of judicial relief not established; conversion-therapy restriction is executive directive not statute and does not bind clergy/alternative practitioners (resident-facing).
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have overturned Pride ban, ordered compensation, and ordered prison transfer/HRT; legal aid/civil petition route worked for residents.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are real but ex-post and case-by-case, so they mitigate rather than erase border/custody exposure for a short-stay traveller.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in brief hold, intrusive questioning, release without imprisonment and court-ordered remedies, but lower because this dossier documents no airport regulation with surgery demanded, segregation as the default custody response, and a 2025 rise with organised ambushes rather than an isolated stop.

Similar in administrative border friction, humiliation, delay and slow/uncertain remedy, but higher than 0.55 because there is no criminalisation, hate-crime enhancement exists, and courts have documented wins for trans claimants, while detention/imprisonment for identity is not the documented norm.

Lower than 0.75: that anchor has trained border officers, accepted matching markers and brief detention with counsel/compensation. Here the main airport lacks regulations, surgery was demanded, and custody segregation is the documented default.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national law is permissive and courts sometimes work for trans people, mitigating societal hostility, but they do not cancel operative border and custody practices. The traveller's decisive encounters are airport screening without protocol, humiliating search/detention, and if detained, segregation rather than identity-congruent placement without a visitor-facing rule. Street risk is patterned through dating-app ambushes and rising 2025 violence, concentrated on trans people. No facility ban, criminalisation or execution pathway is documented. Net: elevated-to-reduced risk, below anchors where border/custody practice is identity-respecting and remedies are routine.
